subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped one-Claw/one-new-agent schema and read-only planning contract as the base of the proposed Claws lifecycle?
rationale: Code review can verify that the slice is gated, read-only, and fail-closed, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently own the new CLI, manifest, package, MCP, cron, provenance, and upgrade model while the governing RFC remains open.

options.title: Accept then land the base
options.body: Approve the RFC contract, rebase and clear current-head checks, then merge this read-only base before its dependent mutation PRs.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce the accepted schema or lifecycle scope before landing, then update this PR and its dependent stack to match the narrower boundary.

options.title: Continue RFC incubation
options.body: Keep this PR and the dependent stack open while maintainers resolve the remaining product and compatibility choices.

recommendation.title: Accept then land the base
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC contract, rebase and clear current-head checks, then merge this read-only base before its dependent mutation PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed product-model review is reflected in the current implementation and RFC, making them the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate for acceptance or narrowing.
